Discovered-from: LP-0MUI6KL3F0094YBS

## Problem

`implement.py start <id>` logs `WARNING: Failed to update stage for <id>` and leaves the work item `open`, because `StatusLifecycle.update_status(id, "in_progress", stage="in_progress")` passes `stage=in_progress` to `wl`, which this project's `wl` rejects:

```
Invalid stage "in_progress". Valid stages: idea, intake_complete, plan_complete, in_review, done.
```

Effect: the claim silently fails; the agent must claim manually (`wl update <id> --status in_progress`). Discovered while implementing LP-0MUI6KL3F0094YBS.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `implement.py start` claims the item to `status=in_progress` without setting an invalid stage (or `StatusLifecycle` tolerates a project whose `wl` stage enum has no `in_progress`).
2. A regression test covers the claim path against the project's actual valid stage set.
data.title: implement.py start fails to claim: this project's wl rejects stage=in_progress
